fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program is designed to train students' language skills. To understand language through training of listening, speaking, reading and writing. To have a good knowledge of about 2000 new Chinese words, and about 180 language points. Be able to communicate in daily life and study and handle common language environment. To learn about the society of China in a general aspect. Students need to preview the text before the classes, take part in class actively, and finish homework after class. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This program includes 3 main courses and lots of elective courses. This program will be divied into three level, primary class, Intermediate class, advanced class according to students language level. Compulsory Courses Level Courses Primary (Zero I II) Primary Intensive Reading, Primary Spoken Chinese, Primary Chinese Listening Intermediate (I II) Intermediate Chinese Intensive Reading, Intermediate Spoken Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Listening, Modern Chinese Conversation, Intermediate Chinese Extensive Reading, Chinese Writing, Intermediate Chinese Grammar, Chinese Newspaper Reading, Translation Advanced (I II) Advanced Chinese Intensive Reading, Advanced Spoken Chinese, Advanced Chinese Listening, Modern Chinese Conversation, Advanced Chinese Extensive Reading, Chinese Writing, Advanced Chinese Grammar, Chinese Newspaper Reading, Translation Elective Course Chinese Calligraphy, Beijing Opera, Chinese Kung Fu, Chinese Medicine, Chinese Massage, Taijiquan, Traditional Chinese Painting, Economics & Trade, Chinese Science & Technology, Chinese Religions, Computer Processing, Chinese Cooking, Chinese Musical Instrument, Chinese Folk Songs Field Training Chinese Life Research, Chinese Language Contest, Visiting Cultural Performance (Folk Music, Chinese Movies, Beijing Opera, Chinese Fine Arts), Slightseeing Guest Lecture Chinese History, Traditional Customs, Chinese Economics, Chinese Calligraphy, Traditional Folk Music, Chinese Medicine, Acupunture, Chinese Martial Arts ​3. School Introduction Editor Notes: Nankai University is a key multidisciplinary and research-oriented university. Nankai University is well known for its healthy environment. By attaching great importance to students' overall development in virtue, intelligence, sporting and art, the University has successfully created a colorful campus cultural atmosphere of elegance and aspiration for the benefit of the students' healthy growth. As a result, being equipped with strong basic knowledge, all-round capability, creativity and practical ability, graduates from Nankai University are extraordinarily popular with employers from all fields , Learn More>> 4. About the College of Chinese Language and Culture Editor Notes: Nankai University is one of only a few Chinese higher educational institutes to start admitting international students. ​ The College was placed as a testing site of Chinese proficiency, HSK, and the Certificate of Chinese Language Instructor for International Students. The College owns modern facilities with high quality. The College has an excellent teacher group, which contains 51 Chinese language teachers, of whom 6 are Professors, 20 are associate Professors and 23 lecturers. Lots of graduates have found jobs in their respective countries in political, economic, cultural, or educational fields. 5. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Mid-autumn Festival Gourmet Festival ​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Proof of no criminal record * 2. Academic transcript of highest education Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. Proof of financial security * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Digital Signature -Please sign your name on a white sheet of paper and send us a scanned copy. -This will be used solely for digitally signing relevant application documents on your behalf. * 6. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 7. 4 Passport photos 4 recent passport-sized photos of the applicant * 8. Certificate/diploma of highest education Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports; must comply with Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. 2.Friendly to China, no criminal record, and willing to comply with Chinese laws and NKU’s regulations. 3.Physically and mentally healthy,meeting the medical examination standards for a Chinese study visa or residence permit. 4.High school graduate; Aged 18 to 50. Applicants under 18 must submit the Application Materials for Admission Under 18 and the Guardian Authorization Letter.
